name: physics_concepts
description: Complete physics definitions with the named quantity or phenomenon, not arithmetic. Matched controls copy supplied terms.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs=[('The capacity to do work is called','energy'),('The product of mass and velocity is called','momentum'),('The rate of change of velocity is called','acceleration'),('The rate of doing work is called','power'),('The force that opposes relative sliding between surfaces is called','friction'),('The tendency of an object to resist changes in its motion is called','inertia'),('The gravitational force acting on a body is its','weight'),('Mass per unit volume is called','density'),('Force per unit area is called','pressure'),('The rate of change of position is called','velocity'),('The number of oscillations per second is called','frequency'),('The distance between adjacent wave crests is called the','wavelength'),('A quantum of electromagnetic radiation is called a','photon'),('The negatively charged particle in an atom is the','electron'),('The positively charged particle in an atomic nucleus is the','proton'),('The electrically neutral particle in an atomic nucleus is the','neutron'),('The bending of light when it enters another medium is called','refraction'),('The bouncing of light off a surface is called','reflection'),('The spreading of waves around obstacles is called','diffraction'),('The force of attraction between masses is called','gravity')]
items=[];control=[]
for prefix in ['Physics: ','Complete the physics definition: ','Science review. ','In introductory physics: ']:
 for d,a in pairs:
  p=prefix+d;items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+a});control.append({'prompt':'Reference term: '+a+'. Copy the reference term. '+p,'answer':' '+a})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
